text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I am going to spectate the Japan 
Cup 
this weekend. Will you join me?

The Japan Cup is an international GI race 
where horsegirls from overseas are invited 
to Japan to compete.

When it was first established, top 
overseas horsegirls 
stood out prominently... but in recent 
years, victories by 
Japanese horsegirls have not been rare at 
all.

This year in particular drew intense 
attention, 
as Japan's lineup was packed with 
powerhouse talent.

As a Trainer, it was a race I felt 
compelled to witness. 
So, I made a promise with Phalaenopsis 
to go watch it at the track together.
choice_data_list:
What made you want to watch it in person, 
though?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Oh, pay it no mind. 
It is quite simple, really—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
To cheer on those who strive and dare to 
challenge. 
Naturally, that is foremost... but there 
is one more thing.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Much like during the summer camp— 
I wished for my classmates to light a fire 
under me.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Now then. 
Shall we go see where my peers stand 
as they forge ahead in the Twinkle Series?

And so arrived 
the day of the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And now, let us introduce the runners 
of the Japan Cup! First up— 
El Condor Pasa!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Her brilliant performance in the NHK Mile 
Cup! 
And surely her fierce clash with Silence 
Suzuka 
in the Mainichi Okan is still fresh in 
everyone's minds!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Looking to win here and build momentum for 
an overseas campaign... 
expectations are soaring for how she'll 
perform today!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¡Bueno! 
Today, I will prove it!! That Japan has 
horsegirls who can defeat the best in the 
world!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
—I am the world's strongest 'Monstrous 
Bird'! 
I'm not handing over this championship 
belt to anyone!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Next up, Air Groove! She delivered a 
stunning run 
in last year's Japan Cup— 
only to suffer a heartbreaking defeat to 
an overseas horsegirl.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Seeking vindication, the Empress returns 
to the turf! 
A powerhouse who previously conquered the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn) 
takes on the world today!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I will clear my name. I will repay my 
debt. 
Only by doing so am I worthy of the title 
I bear.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I shall show them why I am called the 
Empress.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And bringing up the rear, Special Week! 
The Derby horsegirl sprinting at the very 
forefront of racing!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
She tasted bitter defeat against Seiun Sky 
at the Kikuka Sho. 
However, many still believe the strength 
she proved in winning the Japanese Derby 
is the real deal!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The leading star of her generation 
continues to evolve... 
Can she hold off the international field 
and stand at the summit? 
This is the showdown everyone has been 
waiting for!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to become the best horsegirl in 
Japan! 
And to do that—I want to win against the 
horsegirls of the world, too!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Plus, Air Groove-san and El-chan are 
here... 
Everyone is so strong! Not a single one of 
them 
is going to let me pass easily.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
But even so! 
To take one step closer to my dream, let 
me say it!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Today, I'm taking first place!
(WAAAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...The excitement is tremendous, 
even before the race has begun.

The hoofprints carved by Special Week and 
the others 
must have fostered this degree of 
anticipation. 
That was why the frenzy was so intense.

—If anyone can beat the foreign 
horsegirls, they can. 
That conviction resonated tangibly from 
the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text:
"Haaaaaaahhh!" 
"Fuh!! Hah!" 
"Haaaaaaahhh!!"

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Special Week seems to be struggling, 
currently in third! 
Air Groove holds stubbornly in second!! 
—El Condor Pasa crosses the finish line!!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Incredible—first through third are all 
Japanese horsegirls! 
Japan sweeps the top spots, shutting out 
the international field!
(WAAAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(...What was that run from El?! 
Far from letting the overseas horsegirls 
get close... 
she didn't even let Air Groove-dono or Spe 
near her—)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(She accelerated again in the stretch—and 
swept them all away. 
...Against a lineup like this? In a race 
packed exclusively 
with elite champions, she dominated them 
completely.)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Holy crap... At this rate, El Condor Pasa 
could actually win overseas, couldn't she?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(—It was a sprint powerful enough to make 
anyone believe it. 
From the tracks she left behind, to the 
future ahead of her...)

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
...I mean, look at these girls— 
Are Japanese horsegirls really this 
strong?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea Japanese racing itself 
had reached such a high level. 
Watching it got my heart racing!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: (So this is what their racing is...)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(It was not merely about winning. It was 
the thrill and spectacle 
born from champions clashing, crossing 
their honed blades 
against one another.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(Hence, the crowd's wild fervor. 
A radiant heat, truly worthy of 
captivating all eyes.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
And when all was said and done, they had 
convinced everyone— 
convinced them of the sheer "strength" of 
Japanese racing.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(That is... an acclaim my former self 
could never have earned.)
choice_data_list: That was amazing... What a ferocious race!

That was amazing... What an incredible 
race!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(—Now is no time to be overwhelmed. 
Having witnessed today's race, I should 
know full well.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(To show the world the glory of the 
Club... 
I need a groundswell. A fervor that sweeps 
all onlookers into its fold.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: (I, too, must do this.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Heh... They have lit a fire under me, 
far more than I anticipated.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Shall we go, Trainer? Before the roaring 
flame 
stoked within my breast consumes me.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I must pour this kindled fire onto the 
turf.

Watching the Japan Cup seemed to have 
stirred 
something within Phalaenopsis. I prayed 
that this 
would serve as a welcome inspiration—
